summary: Mobile UI and backend medicine-reminder regression coverage completed successfully. Today, tabs, add-form validation, save flow, CRUD, dose logging, history persistence, and overflow checks passed.
action_items: Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable; api.ts currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, which is a deployment-risk mismatch if only the documented variable is provisioned.
Consider adding testID/accessibilityRole to Settings switches and History filter controls for reliable native/mobile regression automation.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts does not read EXPO_BACKEND_URL as specified by the environment contract, although the current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up one TEST_regression_medicine via the regression test; the UI test created TEST_UI_Medicine and it may remain in preview data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL loaded at 390x844. Core UI navigation, add validation/save, no horizontal overflow, backend CRUD, dose status, and history all passed. Prior screenshot strict-locator issue was a test-script ambiguity, not an app failure.
rca_of_issue: Configuration mismatch: frontend/src/api.ts resolves Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the project testing contract specifies frontend/.env EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Current preview traffic succeeds only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is provisioned; deployments exposing only EXPO_BACKEND_URL would construct an invalid /api URL and fail all API-backed screens.
